The prior pulse's allocation already implements the correct response: Product is installing the audited carrier (B1), Runtime is attempting the non-ceiling asymmetric-discovery task-bank certificate (B2), and Intel is separating prompt-underspecification from model incapability on the minimal capability bar (B3). For the three non-critical lanes the question is whether their capped, predeclared-decision-value bets still beat the alternatives; they do. Physics has its strongest recent positive (S1_STATIONARY, audit PASS, producer_claim_supported=true, stationarity skill 0.3196 nats, perm p=9.999e-05, CLASS_PERSISTENCE 1.0) but under a single-vantage, 1800 s right-censored scope, and the single most decision-relevant bound left is vantage transfer, because a vantage-robust intrinsic classifier licenses ONE shared denylist while a vantage-specific one does not. Graph has pivoted off the transport-coupled four-anchor C-FRESHNESS loop (which the global audit recommended PARK) onto C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE under a materially repaired v2 design that fixes the three prior failures: joint intent/goal authorship, a non-distinct reference arm, and unsatisfiable control literals. Frontier holds a genuinely architectural question - whether shortest-path hop is a real acquisition-cost barrier or fresh-instance acquisition is constant-cost via site-native discovery - on a credential-free, K<=3-GET, capped substrate, after its v1 was correctly BLOCKED for an empty sampling frame (0 seeds, 0 DEEP items, 0 hosts) and no pre-freeze certificate. No lane is idle or failed-before-freeze-without-a-plan, so no PARK or TERMINATE is justified this cycle; the honest decision is CONTINUE on all six, with two hard design-contract-v2 guards I am making explicit: Physics must pre-freeze-certify that a second independent egress actually exists and record a bounded operational blocker instead of substituting a fifth single-vantage run, and Runtime/Frontier must satisfy their arithmetically-checkable pre-freeze certificates (dynamic range; DEEP-item attainability) before freezing anything. Local-attractor flags on graph, physics and runtime were treated as diagnostics, not quotas; in each case the cognitive reset confirmed the inherited direction over the fresh-look alternative on merits.
